notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware was attached and no hardware backend was run (this is a simulated R0 world.sim). No deviation from the card: decision family-config and helper MujocoDriver express the card's family:mujoco role, and the card's entry symbol BallBalanceEnv was confirmed at ball_balance_env.py:9. The package serves the card's models[0], assets/ball_balance.xml, as a MuJoCo world: cap.world.step.v1 takes ticks and action.ctrl, bounded per actuator by the model's ctrlrange -1 to 1 on act_x and act_y (assets/ball_balance.xml:25-27), and cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults. The model shape is the full upstream size: qpos 9 (two hinge joints plus one free joint), qvel 8, ctrl 2; no array is reduced. MuJoCo is not installed and cannot be installed where the gate runs (no network, no pip), so the fake backend (fake.py) is a stand-in mujoco module: it parses the MJCF for the joint count, actuator count, control ranges and start positions, but integrates a placeholder first-order hinge motion plus free fall, not MuJoCo's equations, contacts, friction, actuator forces, sensors or noise, and it was never compared with the real engine. The sim path (a backend that backends does not name, which imports the real mujoco) was not run. The bridge serves the raw world (observation time/qpos/qvel; state adds ctrl/tick/timestep/seed), so BallBalanceEnv's 10-value observation selection, constant reward 1.0, obs[2] < 0 termination and 500-step truncation (ball_balance_env.py:20-44, :62-68) are not applied by this driver; the fidelity gaps state this. The fake's 2 ms timestep is a placeholder for MuJoCo's library default because the model sets no <option timestep>; the model's own start positions (.2 .2 .4 for the ball) are read from assets/ball_balance.xml:18. Expected warnings: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND (the fake is a package stand-in class object, so native calls are not recorded and G7 has no fake surface to check) and G8.NO_UNIT x3 (the bridge-derived inputs ticks, action.ctrl and seed). There are no operator-required limits and no site-limits.example.json. Only catalogue cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
